resultJson.title: Add Option manipulation sample
resultJson.body:
Adds `src/main/scala/options/OptionManipulation.scala`, a runnable `@main` demo of common `Option` operations. It covers creation, `map`/`flatMap`/`filter`, safe extraction (`getOrElse`, `orElse`, `fold`), pattern matching, for-comprehensions, and use with collections.

It also defines a small `sequence` extension on `List[Option[A]]` that returns `Some(list)` only when every element is defined.

The diff also includes an `.orca/runs/*.progress.json` run-log file, which is not part of the sample.
